summary: Iteration 10 testing: City Hub + WorldPicker + Biomes (dream/lava/sky/forest) + Hyper Mode + Waterfall + Boss Arena prototypes. Backend regression: 16/18 pytest pass — 2 failures are STALE assertions in pre-existing tests (NOT iter10 regressions): (a) test_speedrun_invalid_zero_ms expected 200 with status:invalid but server now correctly returns 400 (per iter9 recommendation); (b) test_enemy_sprites_available expects flicker.png to NOT exist but file exists (unrelated, pre-iter10). Walking + E hold opens Workshop from shop/upgrade kiosks and WorldPicker (data-testid=world-picker-overlay) from mission kiosk. Did NOT visually drill into deep biome behavior (waterfall trigger, hyper-mode collection, boss-after-clear barrier) — those render inside canvas and require longer scripted gameplay; iter10 spec explicitly calls those a 'playable rough'.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js handleHubInteract: opens workshop OR worldpicker but doesn't close the OTHER if user walks through multiple kiosks with E held. UX: player crossing UPGRADE then MISSION sees Workshop stuck behind WorldPicker. Recommend resetting modal stack on new interactable, or check `showWorkshop`/`showWorldPicker` and ignore subsequent interactable kinds while a modal is open.

WorldPicker.js: clickable card div uses onClick={() => onChoose(w.id)}, but DEPLOY button inside also has data-testid=world-<id>-btn. Clicking the button bubbles to the card's onClick — works fine but double-fires onChoose handler (idempotent so no bug). Add e.stopPropagation on button onClick or remove redundant card onClick for clarity.
Backend test test_speedrun_invalid_zero_ms is stale (server returns 400, test expects 200). Update assertion to status_code == 400.
Backend test test_enemy_sprites_available is stale (asserts flicker.png absent, but it exists). Likely pre-iter10 sprite was added later. Update test.

Hub level uses urban_overgrowth env — biomes/levels.js should ensure hub:true skips combat HUD elements like 'Score: 0' & 'Lives' if intended as pure non-combat zone (currently hearts+score render at top of hub, see screenshot). Minor.

Dream World 'Dream' string is rendered to canvas only (not DOM) so automated DOM assertion can't verify level name; suggest also setting document.title or a hidden data-testid='current-level-name' span for better testability.

Iteration 10 ships 6 new gameplay systems in one pass — hyper_mode pickup, waterfall trigger, bossAfterClear barrier, biome tints, etc — none of which are reachable via DOM assertions. Recommend adding minimal data-testid badges (e.g., 'WATERFALL DESCENT' banner as DOM toast or hidden marker) so future automated tests can validate biome events fired.

rca of the issue: No iter10-introduced regressions. Stacked modals from continuous E-hold across multiple kiosks is a UX quirk, not a functional bug — both modals work independently. Stale backend tests are documentation drift, not server defects.
